posts.author: Gamera
posts.body:
I was making default maps for a game before I parallaxed over them, and OH MY GOD: WHY ARE THE DEFAULT TILES SO BRIGHT???
For some reason, they're both incredibly bright and overly detailed.  They compete for visual attention, and they make me scream just looking at them.  I come from a more traditional pixel art background and realized, to my horror, some of the assets were just shrunk down regular raster drawings.
The horror.  A great strategy in all honesty, but hurts me on a psychic level.
So I ended up recoloring some tiles & making some of my own.  They're just A2 and general floor/wall tiles, and I may or may not post more.
ToS
for the very simple recolors:
1. Feel Free to Edit.
2. As usual, you need to own RPG Maker MZ to use the tiles (but can use them with any other RPG Maker engine)
3. I don't need credit.  Feel free to use for commercial or non-commercial use.

I also made some original tiles from scratch, simple floor and wall tiles.  I'm used to the 16x16 tilesets of 2003, so my brain has to reorganize & reshape my previous regular grids.  At least it's just the tiles x3.
ToS
for my original material:
1. Credit Saturns_day/Gamera or link to this post in a read me so others can find it.
2. Edit all you like.
3. Use for commercial or non-commercial projects.  Just let me know if you do, I like seeing my things in stuff.

I may or may not post more things as I make them.  I've been doing baked-in lighting & tiles for parallax maps, so we'll see if I have more tiles in store.
I don't know if I'll post non-tiles, as my regular sprites are more... sprite like?, than the RTP.  Feel free to use either these tiny ancient Egyptian Canopic Jars or small wall masks from different points of history in your work, with the same TOS as the original sprits.

posts.author: LunarFlareStudios
posts.body: I never really noticed how bright the RTP is... I'd love to see what else you have in store! My only problem with the RTP is how it just doesn't seem versatile enough... but now that I notice the brightness, AAH! I can't unsee it!
